threads.body: `changelog.d/126.enhancement.md` still says the next release adds `gen_ai.workflow.duration`, and Towncrier will render that fragment together with this one. Since the old name was never released, this would advertise an intermediate name and then rename it in the same release. Please update fragment 126 to name `gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration` and drop this redundant fragment so the release notes describe only the API consumers will receive.

threads.body:
The span type registered in `spans.yaml` is `gen_ai.invoke_workflow.internal`, and the `gen_ai.invoke_agent.duration` note just below points at `gen_ai.invoke_agent.internal`. Since this PR is about aligning names with the span type, worth matching the reference here too.

```suggestion
      When this metric is reported alongside a `gen_ai.invoke_workflow.internal` span, the metric value SHOULD be the same as the span duration.
```

Needs a `make generate-all` afterwards so the docs table picks it up.
